--- slide 2: October net sales total is 50.0% above September, but October is missing 2 days: per reported day it is up 55.2%
Metric | October 2026 | September 2026 | Change | Change % | Note
Orders | 20 | 15 | +5 | +33.3% | October partial: 2 days missing; per reported day up 37.9%
Gross sales | $240.00 | $150.00 | +$90.00 | +60.0% | October partial: 2 days missing; per reported day up 65.5%
Refunds | $30.00 | $10.00 | +$20.00 | +200.0% | October partial: 2 days missing; per reported day up 210.3%
Net sales | $210.00 | $140.00 | +$70.00 | +50.0% | October partial: 2 days missing; per reported day up 55.2%
Average order value | $12.00 | $10.00 | +$2.00 | +20.0% | October partial: 2 days missing
Buyers per active day | 8.0 | 6.5 | +1.5 | +23.1% | October partial: 2 days missing
Ad spend | EUR 180.00 | EUR 0.00 | +EUR 180.00 | n/a | September was zero; October: 2 days missing; per reported day up
Return on ad spend | 4.50 | n/a | n/a | n/a | no September figure; October: 2 days missing; on 1 of 29 days
Source: the store's daily order records.
Ad rows: Meta, in the ad account's currency (EUR), purchases in a 7 day click window.
Change % is the change over September's figure, n/a when that was zero. Buyers per active day is the average of each day's distinct buyers, over days with orders. Average order value is gross sales divided by orders.
Per reported day divides a total by the days with orders plus the days with no orders, so months with different numbers of days with data can be compared.

--- slide 7: October refunds total is 200.0% above September, but October is missing 2 days: per reported day it is up 210.3%
Net sales total was $210.00 in October, 50.0% above September ($140.00), but October is missing 2 days: per reported day, net sales are up 55.2% ($7.24 against $4.67).
Orders total was 20 in October, 33.3% above September (15), but October is missing 2 days: per reported day, orders are up 37.9% (0.69 against 0.50).
The biggest move was Refunds, 200.0% above September in total, but October is missing 2 days: per reported day it is up 210.3%.
The best day was Oct 1 with net sales of $150.00.
2 days have no data (Oct 10, Oct 11), so the totals are understated.
Ad spend was EUR 180.00 in October, up EUR 180.00 from September (EUR 0.00), and October is missing 2 days of ad data.
Return on ad spend was 4.50 in October.
2 days have no ad data (Oct 10, Oct 11), so the ad totals are understated.
Narrative written from the computed figures on the previous slides.
--- slide 8: Data health: October is missing days of store and ads data
Source, October | Days with data | Days with nothing to report | Days with no data | Days that may still change | Stored daily figures used
Store | 2 | 27 | 2 | n/a | 12
Ads | 2 | 27 | 2 | 0 | 8
Days with no data in October, store: Oct 10, Oct 11.
Days with no data in October, ads: Oct 10, Oct 11.
A month with days missing is understated, so its changes are marked partial.
For each source, days with data, days with nothing to report and days with no data add up to the days in the month.
A day with nothing to report is one where a data pull ran and found none. A day with no data is one no data pull covered. A day that may still change is one close to the report date: purchases and search figures are restated for a few days.
--- provenance (file property, not on a slide): Written by a fixed template from the computed figures (no model key is set). No model was used.
